description: A gate passed through or silenced step by step, following one of a hundred and thirty-seven fixed patterns

params.text: Picks which pattern the module follows

inputs.text: The clock: a gate above 0.5V advances the pattern one step and, on a step the pattern leaves open, is passed to the output
A gate above 0.5V sends the pattern back to its first step
Moves the pattern selection, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt

outputs.text: A 5V gate on the steps the pattern leaves open, and nothing on the steps it mutes

inputs.0: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
±5V · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
